files.path: 2. Propagation (cuttings and seeds)/_Seed and Cutting Records/Seed Collecting/4. Seed collecting record 2026 updated May 15 26 AA.xlsx
files.purpose_guess: Running 2026 log of seed collected per species, with collection date, collection site, storage status, older stock and who holds it.
files.years_covered: 2024–2026 (collection dates 30 Dec 2024 to 1 Nov 2026; older-seed years 2023–2025)

sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.grain: One seed collection entry (one collection of one species on one date at one site). The species name is filled only on the first row of a species; extra collections of the same species sit on following rows with column A blank (9 such continuation rows).

columns.notes: Botanical names only. Blank on 9 continuation rows. 62 values, all distinct. Contains an apparent truncation or typo ('Cop rham') and a non-species row ('EXTRAS'). Five cells (A6, A7, A23, A53, A57) have red font with no stated meaning.

49 rows hold a real date (24 date type, range 30 Dec 2024 to 1 Nov 2026) or text (25 strings) in d/m/yy, dd/mm/yy, dd/mm/yyyy and d/m/yyyy forms. Real dates carry mixed number formats (mm-dd-yy, mm/dd/yy, m/d/yy, 'mmm yyyy'). Day and month look swapped on at least some date-type cells (see quality issues). 22 of 71 data rows have no date.
SENSITIVE: free-text collection location, 48 filled rows, 26 distinct values. Mix of named planting sites and local place or track names. Values withheld.
Storage or processing state of the seed lot. 46 filled rows. Variants differing only by trailing space ('fridge ' 7 rows, 'uncleaned ' 2 rows). One '?' value.
Year of older stock still held. 20 values stored as floats (2025.0), 3 text values ('frozen') that look like they belong in Status.
Unheaded column, 6 rows, single value 'cuttings?'. Probably a flag that the species may also be propagated by cuttings (low confidence).
Entirely empty within the data range.
Personal names of the person holding or responsible for the seed lot (volunteer or staff name column present). 31 filled rows, 6 distinct. Values withheld.

examples: short free-text condition note, 3 rows (I8, I20, I49)
columns.notes: Unheaded free-text comment column, only 3 rows. Not quoted because the content may describe the seed lot or place.

quality_issues.issue: Profiler header-row guess (row 8) is wrong. The real header is row 2 and the sheet title is in row 1.
Species name only on the first row of a group; later rows of the same species have a blank name, so a naive load orphans 9 collection rows.
quality_issues.evidence: … › Sheet1 › column A, 9 blank cells within A3:A74 (for example A4)

quality_issues.issue: Collected column mixes real dates and text strings in different formats (d/m/yy, dd/mm/yyyy), plus one 'mmm yyyy' cell.
quality_issues.evidence: … › Sheet1 › B3:B74 (25 text, 24 date; B58 formatted 'mmm yyyy')

quality_issues.issue: Future or possibly day/month-swapped dates: one date-type cell is 1 Nov 2026, after the file's own 'updated May 15 26' label. Another date-type cell shows 3 Jul 2026 on a row where text dates are mostly d/m/yy, which suggests a US-style month/day read of a d/m entry (inferred).
Species name problems: truncated or misspelled values and a non-species placeholder.
Status values differ only by trailing whitespace; older-seed column mixes years as floats with the text 'frozen'.
Sheet dimension runs to row 1009 although data ends at row 74 (blank padding).
Red font applied to five species cells without a legend.

Nine species in this record are not in the 90-name list in 'WRT Seed Collection Dates.xlsx' (only 53 of 62 names match exactly after trimming spaces). Some are probable spelling variants, some are genuinely absent.
quality_issues.evidence: … › Sheet1 › A3:A74 compared with WRT Seed Collection Dates.xlsx › Sheet1 › A2:A91

sensitive_columns: C: Site, free-text seed collection location, 48 filled rows, 26 distinct values, text format. Values withheld.
H: With who, personal names of seed holders, 31 filled rows, 6 distinct values. Values withheld.
I: unheaded free-text notes, 3 rows, may contain place descriptions. Values withheld.

files.path: 2. Propagation (cuttings and seeds)/WRT Seed Collection Dates.xlsx
files.purpose_guess: Reference calendar of the usual seed-collection window (month ranges) for each of about 90 native species, with some common names.

sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.grain: One species with its typical seed-collection window as free-text month range.

columns.notes: 90 distinct names, one per row, alphabetical. Four have trailing spaces, one is a single word.
Only 45 of 90 rows filled. Spelling is not standardised ('Toe toe', 'Native Brom').

Free-text month range (a collection window, not a date). 51 of 90 rows filled. Separators vary ('Jan-March', 'Jan - March'), month names are full or abbreviated, a few wrap the year ('Dec-Feb', 'Nov-April'), and one is the word 'Autumn'. Header is misleading because it is a window, not a date.

quality_issues.issue: Collection window stored as free text, not usable as dates without parsing; 39 of 90 species have none.
quality_issues.evidence: WRT Seed Collection Dates.xlsx › Sheet1 › C2:C91

quality_issues.issue: Species-name variants: trailing spaces on four names, an apparent misspelling and a one-word entry.
Common names present for only half the species and inconsistently written.
List has 90 species, which matches neither 93 nor 97 species in other lists. It may be an older or partial list.
No source, author or year on the sheet, so currency cannot be judged.

files.purpose_guess: 2019 GPS export of mapped remnant kōwhai trees, probably as seed-source points (inferred from the file name; low confidence).

sheets.name: (document)
sheets.grain: GPX 1.1 file, about 15 KB, created by GDAL 2.4.1 (a GIS export, not a handheld track). Contains 94 waypoint elements (wpt), each with latitude and longitude attributes (coordinates present, values withheld). No track points, routes, track segments, elevation, timestamps or description tags. The <name> tag is absent; instead each waypoint has an extensions block, 92 with an ogr:ID value and 92 with a type value (two waypoints lack both, so 94 waypoints but 92 labelled). There is one metadata bounds element.

quality_issues.issue: Two of 94 waypoints have no ogr:ID or type extension, so they are unlabelled.
quality_issues.evidence: Remnant_kowhai_2019.gpx › wpt (94) vs ogr:ID (92) and type (92)

quality_issues.issue: Points carry no date, no species field and no link to a seed-collection record, so they cannot be joined to the 2026 collecting record without a manual step. The file is from 2019 and may be out of date.

sensitive_columns: wpt lat/lon attributes: 94 coordinate pairs in decimal-degree GPX format. Values withheld.

open_questions_for_wrt: In the 2026 seed collecting record, are the Collected dates meant to be day/month/year? B3 (1 Nov 2026) and B4 (3 Jul 2026) look swapped or mistyped. Which is right?
What does the red font on five species names in the 2026 seed collecting record mean (for example needs attention, not collected, or collected from somewhere sensitive)?
What do the unheaded columns mean: column F ('cuttings?') and the notes column I?
Is the 'Collection Date' sheet (90 species, month ranges) a current WRT reference or an old guide? Who maintains it, and should its 90 names reconcile with the 93 or 97 species lists elsewhere?
What is 'EXTRAS' in the 2026 seed collecting record: a real seed lot or a note?
Is the 2019 remnant kōwhai GPX the master record of seed-source trees, and does it need to be kept restricted or linked to species and seed lots? Please say who may see the seed location data.
Should the 2026 record's 'With who' column be kept as individual names, or recorded as role or location (for example fridge, freezer, nursery)?
